title: A repeated complete waits on the one host verification already queued for it
description: GY-3525: a worker's complete is interrupted while host admission waits and is run again for the same head and lease epoch. Against a real control plane, isolated Postgres and the host pump, only one verification is queued and executed; the repeat receives its result and submits through the unchanged review and acceptance gates.

steps.name: repeated and interrupted complete requests share one host verification
